This bill makes changes to support a new framework for managing industrial chemicals after they are used and disposed of.
The Minister would set controls on industrial chemicals through scheduling decisions that apply across their lifecycle.
The bill also fixes an error in a delegations power in the Industrial Chemicals Act 2019.
Amends the Industrial Chemicals Act 2019 to support the collection of a scheduling charge alongside the existing registration charge.
Prevents the scheduling charge from being credited to the Industrial Chemicals Special Account.
Corrects an error in a delegations power in the Industrial Chemicals Act 2019.
Registered introducers of industrial chemicals would be affected.

The Industrial Chemicals Legislation Amendment Bill 2020 enables collection of a scheduling charge alongside the existing registration charge under the Industrial Chemicals Act 2019, reduces administrative burden on business, clarifies payment management, and corrects a drafting error in delegation powers.
